## Activity

This report summarises activity at Harbour Eye Clinic during March 2021. The clinic recorded 298 captures during the reporting period. Capture activity proceeded as planned, with session lists operating as scheduled apart from routine leave. No other operational issue is noted in the available information. The activity total provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures reported below.

## Image quality

Of the 298 captures, 13 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 4.4 per cent. The result indicates that most captured images were suitable for assessment. The ungradable cases remain relevant to service monitoring, as they identify images that could not be assessed through the usual grading process. The reported rate is presented against total capture activity for the period.

## Grading

Grading identified 64 referable results from the capture activity. The median lag between image capture and grading was 1 day. This indicates that the central point of the grading turnaround distribution was 1 day. Together, the referable result count and median lag provide a summary of clinical grading output and timeliness for the month. Overall, the available figures show completed capture activity, recorded image-quality outcomes and grading performance for Harbour Eye Clinic.
